comparison_rule: Compare complete float64 arrays exactly, retain every unequal index/value/delta and bitwise identity with no numerical tolerance. Compare both full NPZ bytes/length/SHA against historical archive-record identities. Report every condition; select no capability.
controls_rule: Both unset runs require bitwise all-field parity against original frozen forward, exact current V5 utilities/pixels/captions/output hashes, and raw NPZ/components byte equality with their first-attempt unset counterpart. Both new unset raw, components and all-field parity files must be byte-identical. Any control failure makes the entire new diagnostic uninterpretable. All five cases must complete; retain partial evidence without promoting the old result. No missing child receipt is interpreted as zero resource use.

first_attempt.default_failure: Reconstructed inputs changed before any recorded forward calls; actual failed input tensors and identities were not saved. Cause remains unresolved.

forward_contract.hidden_state: NeuralOutput returns exactly four tensors and no hidden-state field. Inventory drift fails; no returned field may be omitted.
forward_contract.operation_order: model.decode(model.step(model.encode(batch.observation, saved_latent_noise), "couple"), None), exactly original fixed_output action=0, teacher=False except replacing the local RNG draw with saved bytes.
forward_contract.parameter_configuration_check: Before and after inference require identical complete model/observer state_dict hashes and architecture/configuration, full module class/extra_repr/training flags and parameter requires_grad inventory. Current model config is pinned to current_assets.
forward_contract.parity: For every batch in both unset conditions, additionally call frozen learning.forward(model,batch,0,noise_seed,False,costs,parity_name) once. Compare dtype, shape and every tensor byte for all four outputs before quantization; no tolerance, including signed-zero differences. Save every field hash and parity. Any mismatch fails that case and the whole diagnostic.
forward_contract.rng: Saved-noise forward draws no random values and must leave global Torch RNG state unchanged. Reference forward intentionally regenerates its original private Generator noise. It may consume a different private RNG sequence from the explicit-input path; visible tensor inputs, parameters and returned outputs must remain identical in both unset controls.

historical_raw_identity_comparison: Every new save_hard NPZ is compared by full byte length and SHA256 against its original V3 ARCHIVE_INTEGRITY member. Record every case result. Utility equality alone never establishes raw identity.
interpretation_rules: All inference cases see the same exact prepared tensors, including latent noise; this removes reconstruction/RNG differences as interventions between those five cases. The conditioning choice is current unset AVX512 input construction, not an assertion about historical inputs.

Observed differences describe dispatch sensitivity on the current host, current frozen generator and observers, and this already consumed batch. They do not identify the historical CPU, environment or cause of the original mismatch.
ATEN_CPU_CAPABILITY controls ATen native dispatch, not every linked MKL/oneDNN implementation. An observed capability flag does not prove that every operator changed ISA.

Exact full historical utility equality is distinct from raw-byte identity. Only equality of complete NPZ length and SHA permits saying newly reconstructed bytes match historical recorded identity; never say the original storage copy was recovered.
Fixed-pixel MSE substitution can test whether that arithmetic alone is sufficient on those fixed current pixels. It cannot reconstruct unknown historical pixels or prove historical causality.

Retain all cases and all negative/failed outcomes. No closest/best ISA selection, tolerance change, old audit overwrite, new holdout access or admission. Historical scientific FAIL and raw-upload approval block remain unchanged.

This checks only seed17 frozen original action0 endpoints. Even exact reconstruction would not establish seed29/43 or learned ordinary48 checkpoint/trajectory replay, and cannot close the original historical regression gate.
Explicit dispatch cases use fixed latent noise prepared under unset. They are conditional fixed-input interventions, not end-to-end reruns of original per-dispatch random draws.

The fixed-pixel arithmetic probe holds uint8 bytes and target tensors fixed, while dequantization via float()/255 and MSE execute under each case. It tests that pipeline jointly, not an individually isolated mean/reduction operator.
mse_only_subanalysis: Only after all cases and unset controls pass, substitute each condition fixed-current-pixel MSE into the unset discrete primitives. Use Python floats in the original ordered Python3.12 sum; never let NumPy scalar promotion change arithmetic. Check exact unset reconstruction and compare full old/current utilities. No additional model calls.

official_sources.verified: x86 env values default,avx2,avx512; invalid values ignored with warning; get_cpu_capability uses a static cached value. Explicit AVX values require compiled support and do not repeat the automatic hardware feature test.
x86 CPUCapability::DEFAULT is reported as NO AVX; other two values report AVX2/AVX512.
Bitwise equality across platforms and mathematically equivalent batch/slice operations is not guaranteed.

phases.inference: The parent first records the preparation result and full snapshot-manifest SHA in START.json. Each of five fresh isolated processes verifies that same manifest and every array/file byte, then creates tensor views without make_batch/panels/load_corpus_roles or random draws. Only two unset original-forward parity calls regenerate their original private noise; these are additional counted model calls.
phases.prepare: A separate unset process loads only the two existing development source roles, constructs the original twenty batches, verifies complete saved current V5 panel identities, and draws each latent noise with the exact frozen torch.Generator().manual_seed(noise_seed); torch.randn(batch_size,96) expression. No neural model may be constructed or invoked. Save every tensor and metadata before child cases.

registration_rule: Commit PROTOCOL.json and all five Python sources including tests.py together before preparation or model execution. The runner verifies each exact Git-tree blob. Every correction after execution requires a separate attempt; preserve all prior failures. No import of first-attempt executable code.
resource_rule: Before each accounted full generator/observer call, LimitedCosts rejects any count or example-budget excess. Independently, Python profiling rejects any extra generator encode entry before its neural body, counts decode entries separately, and bounds observer forward entry. Successful cases require started=decoded=ledger generator counts and observer equality; failures preserve all three. A missing/invalid child RESULT means unknown actual usage, never zero: resource_accounting_complete=false, actual_totals=null, sealed-subset counts and each reserved per-case upper bound remain explicit. First-attempt actual usage stays separate.
retained_outputs: Every generated uint8 pixel and UTF-8 caption in original save_hard NPZ format
Every utility for both observers in original order
Every observer score primitive, classification, joint loss and refinement charge
Per-row combined hard-output, pixel, caption, image-logit and image-probability hashes
Float32 MSE of the unchanged saved V5 pixels under each dispatch condition, requiring no extra model calls
All differing utility indices, values and deltas against old V3 and existing V5 arrays
Every stdout/stderr, failed or partial result and actual resource count
Complete public, target and latent-noise input snapshot and per-array/full-file hashes
All four output-field byte identities for every batch and original-forward parity in both unset cases
Preparation/child stdout, stderr, failed or partial receipts, independent function-entry counts and disk checks
scope: A separately registered bounded diagnosis on the same already consumed seed17 development task and clean panels. It conditions on input tensors prepared under current unset AVX512 dispatch. It is neither a candidate retry, old-gate change, new-holdout experiment, archive restoration nor field-policy benefit claim.

snapshot_format.file_format: 20 uncompressed allow_pickle=False NPZ files task-000..015.npz and clean-000..003.npz plus MANIFEST.json; exclusive writes; no unknown files
snapshot_format.metadata: Exact condition, source-ID pairs and their order, batch index/boundaries, noise_seed, original public/target hashes. Each array has dtype/shape/byte length/SHA256; each NPZ has whole-file SHA/length. all_input_sha256 hashes the complete canonical ordered batch inventory. Parent START binds full manifest bytes.
snapshot_format.mutation_check: Each child verifies all input tensors after inference and rereads the unchanged snapshot from disk. Preparation and every child record the same registered sources. No float tolerance.
snapshot_format.parent_binding: The parent records the full snapshot manifest/preparation-result identity. Every child receives the exact parent-record SHA via argv and verifies it, registered protocol SHA, all five cases, complete preparation result, snapshot manifest and aggregate input hash before model inference.

storage_bounds.final_metadata_check: Before SUMMARY is written, serialize its complete annotated UTF-8 bytes and add existing parent/preparation metadata bytes (exclude separately bounded case/snapshot directories). If total exceeds 16MiB, retain all child evidence and write only compact FAIL summary with child receipts, actual/unknown counts, full unwritten summary length/hash and measured metadata usage; execution_complete=false and diagnostic_interpretable=false. If existing metadata already exceeded the bound, the compact failure still reports within_bound=false; no successful bound claim. No model retry.
storage_bounds.rule: Before preparation and before each child, record f_bfree, f_bavail, effective UID and remaining output bound. Only effective UID 0 uses f_bfree as allocatable; other users use f_bavail. Require allocatable >= remaining output bound + 256MiB reserve. Preserve failure and launch no further stage when insufficient. Do not claim f_bavail is positive. Recheck inside every child to reduce shared-filesystem races; remaining filesystem races remain possible.
